lines.en: I bob and drift through the air
I find my way with one eye
My wings beat fast
I fly around that tree
I slip between the leaves
I look down once
I drift toward the shape of a person
I drift over a meadow
Hovering still, my eyeball turns half a circle.
I rise and dip as if in water
I skim the ground for a stretch
I edge your way
I hang in the air, staring
A whole eye hovering, never blinking.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀还在扇，没停过
lines.en: My wings keep beating
My shadow moves on the ground below
I'm looking your way

lines.zh: 我没有身体，只有眼和翅
lines.en: I've no body, only an eye and wings
There's a little red in my eye
I drift a little left and right

lines.zh: 我不知道自己在等什么
lines.en: I don't know what I'm waiting for
At night I see more clearly
I circle the same spot
The wind can't shift me
I look at you and you look at me

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比你整个头都大
lines.en: My eye is bigger than your head
You look away and I come closer
You stare at me and I hold still
Something in you beats
I see it

lines.zh: 你看不见我身后的东西
lines.en: You can't see what's behind me
I move around to the other side

lines.zh: 你的倒影在我的眼睛里
lines.en: Your reflection sits inside my eye
I've memorized you now
Whatever you do, don't look back
I've been right here all along
I hear your breath
Do you mean to run off
I tumble once
My wings stutter

lines.zh: 我升高了一点，眼睛贴着你。
lines.en: I rose a bit, my eye right on you.
A red line crosses my eye
I withdraw into the dark
I stare harder
Not even my wings make a sound
I slowly descend again
I'm still watching
I drift to your other side
Your hand is bright
Light draws me
That bit of heat; I like it
Keep holding it up
I want to come a little closer
See, here I am
Retreat, and I follow
That thing in your hand is moving.
Let me get a good look at it
Only for a little while
You hit me and I tilt
I spin once to steady
My eye white smacks into your nose.
You pass underneath me
The blow floats me backward
My eye comes right up to you
We both hit a branch
I back off half a meter
Then I drift back
I'm not heavy, but I won't yield
Another flies in the night
Two eyes meet
It's a size larger than me
We turn in slow circles together
Its wingbeat is lower than mine
We fly pressed close
The beasts below scatter
We two eyes make no sound
This stretch of night sky serves two
We rise together
I catch it between my wings
I've no hands to hold it
It hangs and sways on me
I flick it rolling twice with my wingtip.
It falls; I dive after it
It's heavier than I am
I wedge it in a fork
I've nowhere to keep it
I let go and it drops
Then forget it
You turned your back
I'm right above you

lines.zh: 活人的热气，勾着我的瞳。
lines.en: Living warmth pulls at my pupil.
I drop a little lower
I begin circling you
You looked up for me
I've already moved
I'm ready to dive
You didn't look up
This angle is right
The back of your neck is exposed
I'm coming down
I'm right behind you
Did you hear the wingbeat
Watch ahead; I'm right behind your ear.
You turn your head and I rise
You're looking for one eye
There are three of us here
I bump your shoulder
Hit and retreat; you never get a grip.
You raise a hand and I climb

lines.zh: 我贴着树影，一寸寸逼近。
lines.en: Hugging the tree shadows, I close inch by inch.
However fast you run, I stay
I needn't land at all
You can't hit the sky
I wait for you to slacken
You're leaning on a tree
That's even better
I make one more full circle
I ram your chest
My eye drives into your face
You recoil and I bounce back
My wing beats at your ear
I hit the back of your head

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也翻过去
lines.en: That flips me over too
I can't bite, but I can hit
You swing and I climb half a meter
And down I come again
You're knocked onto the ground
I circle your head
Your hand can't reach me
An eye opens in midair
First I'm a point of light
My wings sound in the dark
I drift out of the canopy
The night air stirs

lines.zh: 我悬在离地两格的地方
lines.en: I hang a couple of blocks up

lines.zh: 有一只眼睛看着这片地
lines.en: An eye keeps watch over this ground
I make one turn first
You're below; I see you clearly
My one eye narrows
I come down from high up

lines.zh: 我的影子先落在你脚边
lines.en: My shadow lands at your feet first
I patrol this sky now
The firelight stings and I float higher

lines.zh: 我被砸到地上，弹了两下
lines.en: I'm smashed to the ground and bounce

lines.zh: 水沾住我的翅膀，我飞不动
lines.en: Water catches my wings and I can't fly
The blast flings me far
An arrow grazes my eye

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的瞳孔缩小
lines.en: That force shrinks my pupil
I find nothing living tonight

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我什么都看不见
lines.en: A flash and I can see nothing at all
No wind here, and no ground
